target.auth_method: static token from environment (helper contract); token acquisition is operator-owned

checks.reason: requires an operator-controlled Vault HA cluster and a failover event; not automated by this harness
Vault Transit envelope mode is NOT implemented; this run does not claim Transit support

checks.detail: helper put/get returned byte-identical 32-byte key material (bytes not logged)
nxs1 envelope encrypt/decrypt succeeded with the Vault-held key and failed closed with a different key; plaintext and key bytes were not logged
KV entry was replaced with a new 32-byte key and the new key was read back (bytes not logged)
invalid token produced a nonzero helper exit and empty stdout
disposable child token was revoked, then produced a nonzero helper exit and empty stdout
deliberately unreachable endpoint produced a nonzero helper exit and empty stdout; no fallback key source was used
acceptance key metadata was deleted from the dedicated path

limitations: This harness verifies Vault KV v2 custody only. Vault Transit envelope mode is NOT implemented and is not tested.
Real Vault HA failover, long-running token renewal, and auth methods other than a static token are NOT exercised by this run.
This harness does not start a full gateway process; it verifies helper key load and the nxs1 decrypt path with that key.
Dev-mode Vault is never production evidence; evidence_class=dev is reported for explicit --allow-dev runs.
Reports contain no token values or key bytes; they record only statuses, redacted endpoints, policy names, and topology metadata.
